<style>
.sd-links {

.sd-btn {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 5px 14px;

  border: 1.5px solid #5654A2;
  background: #EEEDF8;
  color: #5654A2;
  font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.82em;
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
}
.sd-btn:hover {
  background: #5654A2;
  color: #F8F7F0;
  text-decoration: none;
}
@media (max-width: 520px) {
  .sd-links { flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }
  .sd-btn { width: 150px; text-align: center; }
}
</style>
